g.text: the same site as couchers.org, shared across web + apps;
where most of our day-to-day changes happen
loaded from the web (live, on every use)
Most changes land here - no release at all.
staging on every push to develop,
prod manually via the ops console.
Rare: Expo upgrades, new native modules.
The fingerprint is a hash of everything in (1) that could break (2):
an OTA update is only applied if its fingerprint matches the installed app.
